title: Fuse
summary: FUSE, verb transitive s as z. [Latin fundo, fusum, to pour out.] To melt; to liquefy by heat; to render fluid; to dissolve. FUSE, verb intransitive To be melted; to be reduced from a solid to a fluid

inlines.v: FUSE, verb transitive s as z. [Latin fundo, fusum, to pour out.] To melt; to liquefy by heat; to render fluid; to dissolve. FUSE, verb intransitive To be melted; to be reduced from a solid to a fluid state by heat.
